statement: The v0-draft rubric (five properties, Stages 0-2) has been applied once, by hand, to one listed project: integer-mult-bounds, graded Stage 1 in the 2026-10-16 smoke test.
status: Draft rubric with one hand-run assessment; no probe tooling or assessment-record format yet.
scope: One project, of one shape (a single exact bound with certificates). Two orientation probes, one verification probe and two measurements, run ad hoc. Not yet tested on a benchmark, replication or conjecture-style project, or with a donor-tier probe model.

assumptions.statement: Probe answers on the same commit agree (two probes agreed once).
The thresholds in spec §3.2 are sensible (uncalibrated).
A routine reassessment costs about two short donor sessions (estimated, not measured).
